subject: EU compliance onboarding: mutual action plan & readout plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Muller <anna.muller@nordbank.eu>, Julien Dupont <julien.dupont@eudatahub.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: EU compliance onboarding: mutual action plan & readout plan

Hi Anna / Julien —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. As discussed, we want to get a concise mutual action plan (MAP) in place that aligns on the evaluation checklist (privacy, transfer model, technical controls), owners, and a target close window so NordBank can complete its procurement and compliance review on schedule. I attached a first-pass timeline that breaks out the items we talked about.

High level asks from Redwood for this first MAP iteration:
- Confirm primary legal/privacy contact at NordBank
- Identify the team that will own cross-border transfer sign-off (legal or privacy) and their expected review lead time
- Confirm any stricter-than-GDPR residency constraints (e.g., explicit onshore-only clauses for any dataset)
- Sign off on proposed readout cadence (weekly 30-min sync + one technical deep-dive)

Proposed owners (internal): Marcus Lin — infra & deployment constraints; Neha Kapoor — privacy & data classification; Lauren Bishop — program owner for MAP execution.

I propose a 30-minute readout next week to align owners and finalize the timeline. Suggested slots (CEST):
- Tue 27 Apr 09:30–10:00 CEST
- Wed 28 Apr 15:00–15:30 CEST

Attached: MAP_onboarding_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) and redwood_data_flow_v2.png (diagram).

If this looks good, please confirm the best slot and point person on your side. We’ll circulate an updated MAP after the readout.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Anna Muller <anna.muller@nordbank.eu>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Julien Dupont <julien.dupont@eudatahub.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU compliance onboarding: mutual action plan & readout plan

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the timeline. I’m NordBank’s project lead for this evaluation; I’ll coordinate internally but will need input from two teams: Legal (David Rieder) for contract/residency terms and Privacy (Sofia Becker) for DPIA and data handling details. I’ve copied our legal contact below in the calendar invite draft I’ll send once we confirm a slot.

Notes from our side:
- We will require an explicit note in the MAP if any processing will occur outside the EU/EEA — our procurement needs this for final approval.
- We expect a privacy impact outline and a sample data retention policy by the technical deep-dive.
- Recommended internal review window: 7–10 business days for Legal once they have the finalized MAP and diagram.

Of your proposed slots, Wed 28 Apr 15:00–15:30 CEST works best. I will send a calendar invite and include David & Sofia for the readout.

Attachment: NordBank_questions_v1.docx (short Qs)

Best,
Anna Muller
Head of Cloud Procurement | NordBank
anna.muller@nordbank.eu
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Anna Muller <anna.muller@nordbank.eu>, Julien Dupont <julien.dupont@eudatahub.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU compliance onboarding: mutual action plan & readout plan

Thanks — tagging in next steps from our side and proposed short checklist so we’re aligned before the readout.

Internal owners & immediate actions:
- Marcus Lin (infra): confirm whether the requested workload can be scoped to EU-only nodes and provide a short note on fallback behaviour if capacity/DR requires cross-border routing. Deliverable: infra note (one page) by Mon 26 Apr EOD.
- Neha Kapoor (privacy): draft a DPIA outline and the sample retention policy (to match NordBank’s ask) by Tue 27 Apr EOD.
- Jordan: will own MAP updates and coordinate the readout calendar.

Proposed readout agenda (30 min):
1) Roll call & success criteria (5 min)
2) High-level data flows & residency constraints (10 min)
3) Legal & privacy asks + timelines (10 min)
4) Next steps and owners (5 min)

I’ll pull a slimmed MAP doc from Jordan’s attachment and share via Drive before the meeting. Marcus — can you confirm the infra note timeline? Neha — can you confirm DPIA draft timing?

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Customer Strategy | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Muller <anna.muller@nordbank.eu>, Julien Dupont <julien.dupont@eudatahub.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU compliance onboarding: mutual action plan & readout plan

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Anna — Wed 28 Apr 15:00–15:30 CEST is confirmed. I accepted the calendar invite and have added the Drive link with the MAP draft and diagrams: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC-MAP_onboarding_timeline

Immediate next actions (we’ll track in the MAP spreadsheet):
- NordBank: designate primary legal (& cc privacy) for contract/residency approvals (Anna to confirm in invite)
- Redwood (Marcus): infra note by Mon 26 Apr EOD
- Redwood (Neha): DPIA outline & retention sample by Tue 27 Apr EOD
- Redwood (Lauren): distribute slim MAP and run the readout agenda

We’ll aim to have the MAP to a sign-off-ready state (procurement/legal) within 10 business days after the readout, contingent on NordBank’s legal review window. If anything changes before Wednesday, please flag here. Looking forward to the readout.

—Jordan
